relations: A reflective optical disc rests flat on a light wood-grain surface, casting faint shadows beneath its rim.
Tilting the disc or moving the light source shifts the iridescent rainbow bands across its polished face.
If a lateral force is applied, the disc slides across the wood grain while maintaining its flat orientation.
The central hole and hub ring remain fixed relative to the disc body during any rotation or translation.
